name: effect-atom
title: New Effect Atom
description: Creates a named CSS effect token alias from an existing float or inset preset, preserving its elevation-token dependency and atom metadata.

settings.name: name
settings.title: Atom Name
settings.description: Lowercase kebab-case name for the CSS custom property, without leading --.

settings.name: title
settings.title: Title
settings.description: Optional display title for the generated effect atom; defaults to its name.

settings.name: description
settings.title: Description
settings.description: Optional description for the generated effect atom.

settings.name: indexed
settings.title: Include in Index
settings.description: Whether the generated item should appear in its project manifest.

settings.name: location
settings.title: Atoms Folder
settings.description: Parent folder that will contain the new named atom folder.

settings.name: preset
settings.title: Source Preset
settings.description: Existing template used to create the named atom.
